title: Riverscape acceptance checks
description: A coverage map, not a test result. Run evidence belongs to a commit and environment. Linked tests show where to look, not proof that a check passed. A browser rendering wallpaper.html is not a native wallpaper check.

checks.claim: A fresh tank keeps the current population and behavior.
checks.note: The original count of 24 applied at issue 01's stage. The final product starts at 8; retain swimming, feeding and cursor behavior.

checks.claim: Restarting restores fish IDs, species, and ages without duplicates.
checks.procedure: Save while paused; compare IDs, species and ages after reload. Repeat in the native dev app after quit/relaunch.

checks.claim: Each display restores its own tank without overwriting another tank.
checks.procedure: Use two physical displays with distinct saved populations; export mapping and snapshots before quit/relaunch and unplug/replug. Compare per-display tank and fish IDs, and check the other tank did not change.

checks.claim: A missing or invalid save starts a usable tank; storage failures do not stop the scene.
checks.procedure: Exercise missing, invalid and unsupported data and denied writes in isolated storage, not production saves.

checks.claim: Pausing or closing does not advance age on return.
checks.procedure: Compare ages across a timed pause and saved reload; repeat native quit/relaunch and sleep/wake. Allow only measured running time.

checks.claim: Swimming, feeding, cursor reactions, and power controls still work.
checks.procedure: Feed and move the cursor; check pause, coverage, low power and sleep in the real host. Model tests alone do not verify macOS events.

checks.claim: Tests cover save round trips, invalid data, and the simulation clock.
A new tank starts with fewer than 24 fish.
checks.procedure: Assert exactly 8 fish in a new isolated tank.

checks.claim: Only mature fish can breed, and babies visibly grow before becoming eligible.
checks.procedure: Check eligibility with tests; inspect size stages and normal-speed swimming. Label accelerated growth demonstrations, never present them as natural pacing.

checks.claim: Births never exceed the cap, even when adults become eligible together.
Growth and breeding progress survive restart.
checks.procedure: Compare each saved age and breedIn, and tank breedIn, before/after a paused reload; repeat native restart.

checks.claim: Growth and breeding stop with simulation; no offline catch-up.
Babies swim, avoid neighbours, and feed without size-related glitches.
checks.procedure: View mixed ages at desktop scale, including food and cursor interaction, plus a close-up for clipping.

checks.claim: Controlled-clock and random-source tests cover maturity, cooldowns, saving and the cap.
Check crowding and frame cost at the cap in preview and wallpaper.
checks.procedure: Review desktop-scale motion; separately measure uncaptured, paced browser and native runs with environment and resolution. Do not infer timing from a recording.
